core_meaning.primary_meaning: Nurain is an Arabic-origin name meaning “Two lights”.
core_meaning.literal_meaning: The name is the Arabic word itself, used unchanged as a given name rather than a derived or diminutive form.
core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Nurain corresponds to the Arabic form نُورَيْن (Arabic نُور (nūr) + dual ending). Its core sense is nurain; two lights. Nurain is Arabic نُورَيْن (Nūrayn) 'two lights', from نُور (nūr) 'light'. The source gloss 'Light' is broadly consistent. Same name as noorain.
